Methods

ParameterDescription

Clears the text content (sends an embed-only or component-only message).

Builds and appends an embed using the provided configuration action.

ParameterDescription
configureA delegate that configures the .

Removes all embeds from the builder.

Appends a message component (button, select menu, action row, etc.).

Removes all components from the builder.

Appends a sticker by ID (max stickers). Stickers must belong to the server.

AsTts()

Enables text-to-speech for this message.

SuppressEmbeds()

Prevents Discord from creating link-preview embeds for any URLs in the message content.

SuppressNotifications()

Sends the message without triggering desktop push notifications for mentioned users. Useful for bulk announcements or status updates that don't need to interrupt users.

WithAllowedMentions(AllowedMentions allowedMentions)

Controls who Discord will mention when the message is delivered.

ParameterDescription
allowedMentionsUse factory shortcuts such as , , or construct a custom instance.

WithReply(ulong messageId, bool failIfNotExists)

Sends this message as an inline reply to .

ParameterDescription
messageIdThe ID of the message to reply to.
failIfNotExistsWhen true, Discord will return an error if the target message has been deleted. Defaults to false so the message is sent as a standalone message if the target is gone.

WithMessageReference()

Sets a raw on the message.

WithPoll()

Attaches a poll to the message.

WithNonce(string nonce, bool enforce)

Sets an opaque nonce string (max characters) that clients can use to verify a message was sent.

ParameterDescription
nonceThe nonce value.
enforceWhen true, Discord checks that this nonce was not used recently and rejects the message if it was (idempotency protection).

sections.title: PawSharp.API.Clients
sections.content:
PawSharp.API.Clients

Implementation of Discord REST API client with rate limiting.

sections.title: PawSharp.API.Clients.DiscordRestClient
sections.content:
PawSharp.API.Clients.DiscordRestClient

Constructors

DiscordRestClient()

Convenience overload — creates a default internally. Consumers that register DiscordRestClient directly (e.g. via AddHttpClient) without calling AddAdvancedRateLimiter() will use this overload automatically.

Methods

JsonContent()

Wraps an object as a UTF-8 JSON using Discord-compatible serializer options.

SendFilesAsync()

Sends up to 10 file attachments in a single message. Each element is a (Stream stream, string fileName) pair.

ModifyGuildMfaLevelAsync()

Modifies the guild's MFA level (requires the current user to be the guild owner). Returns the updated MFA level on success.

ExecuteSlackCompatibleWebhookAsync()

Executes a webhook using the Slack-compatible endpoint.

ExecuteGitHubCompatibleWebhookAsync()

Executes a webhook using the GitHub-compatible endpoint.

GetGuildWidgetAsync()

GET /guilds/{id}/widget.json — public rendered widget (no auth required).

SendSoundboardSoundAsync()

POST /channels/{channel.id}/send-soundboard-sound

ModifyCurrentUserVoiceStateAsync()

PATCH /guilds/{guild.id}/voice-states/@me

ModifyUserVoiceStateAsync()

PATCH /guilds/{guild.id}/voice-states/{user.id}

GetUserApplicationRoleConnectionAsync()

GET /users/@me/applications/{application.id}/role-connection

UpdateUserApplicationRoleConnectionAsync()

PUT /users/@me/applications/{application.id}/role-connection

ExchangeCodeAsync()

Exchanges an authorization code for an access token. Sends a direct POST oauth2/token with form-encoded body — the client's bot token is NOT attached to this request.

RefreshTokenAsync()

Uses a refresh token to obtain a new access token. Sends a direct POST oauth2/token with form-encoded body — the client's bot token is NOT attached to this request.

RevokeTokenAsync()

Revokes an OAuth2 access or refresh token. POST /oauth2/token/revoke. The client's bot token is NOT attached to this request.

CreateGroupDmAsync()

Creates a new Group DM channel. POST /users/@me/channels. Requires access tokens of the target users with the gdm.join OAuth2 scope.

LogSanitizedApiErrorAsync()

Logs API failures with sanitized response content to prevent accidental secret exposure. Keep response-body logging behind this helper for consistency across future call sites.

Fields

_jsonOptions

Shared serializer options: Discord's REST API requires lowercase snake_case field names. Using JsonNamingPolicy.SnakeCaseLower means C# properties like "GuildId" become "guild_id" automatically, even without [JsonPropertyName] on every request model. Null values are omitted to keep payloads minimal.
